CrowdStrike and Zscaler did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment. CrowdStrike's Falcon platform is widely used to secure endpoints such as laptops, servers and mobile devices, while Zscaler specializes in cloud-based network security services that help companies securely connect users to applications without relying on traditional corporate networks. Founded in 2011 by chief executive George Kurtz, CrowdStrike has grown into one of the world's largest cybersecurity companies, helping organizations detect and respond to cyber threats through its cloud-native software platform. The Austin, Texas-based company has expanded beyond endpoint protection through acquisitions and internal development into areas including cloud, identity and threat intelligence security. The deal would address one of CrowdStrike's biggest gaps in network security and help it compete more directly with platform providers such as Palo Alto Networks. Zscaler, founded in 2007 by chief executive Jay Chaudhry, pioneered zero-trust security, which continuously verifies users and devices before granting access to corporate applications and data. Its cloud-based software lets employees securely access applications from any location. Any transaction would likely require the backing of Chaudhry, who remains Zscaler's largest shareholder. The discussions come as cybersecurity companies race to expand offerings to meet demand for integrated platforms that address a wider range of threats. Zscaler's shares fell sharply earlier this year in a broader software selloff as investors weighed the impact of artificial intelligence, but have since rebounded. Bloomberg News first reported on the merger discussion.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Amazon Stocks Fall 3.87% as Its $188 Billion Anthropic Stake Starts Trading Daily
item.description: AMZN dropped 3.87% to $257.37 at the 4:00 p.m. ET close on November 19, the worst move among the Anthropic-linked mega-caps on the day of the AI lab's debut. Consumer discretionary was the weakest S&P ...
item.content:encoded:
News / GuruFocus / Amazon Stocks Fall 3.87% as Its $188 Billion Anthropic Stake Starts Trading Daily

Amazon Stocks Fall 3.87% as Its $188 Billion Anthropic Stake Starts Trading Daily Less than 1 min read

AMZN ANT Amazon.com AMZN dropped 3.87% to $257.37 at the 4:00 p.m. ET close on November 19, the worst move among the Anthropic-linked mega-caps on the day of the AI lab's debut. Consumer discretionary was the weakest S&P 500 sector in a broad 2% selloff. Amazon is Anthropic's biggest shareholder. It holds about 1.94 billion non-voting shares, or 14.6%, after investing roughly $18 billion, Fortune reported from the final prospectus. The commercial tie is even larger. Anthropic has committed $110 billion to Amazon through April 2036, Forbes noted in its analysis, payable regardless of usage, or about $11 billion a year. Amazon already booked $62.9 billion of gains on private investments in the first nine months of 2026, mostly from Anthropic.

At Anthropic's $97.17 close, Amazon's stake is worth about $188 billion, roughly 6.8% of Amazon's $2.78 trillion market value on GuruFocus. That cuts both ways, because each $1 move in Anthropic's shares changes the stake by about $1.9 billion and can whipsaw reported net income. The GuruFocus chart shows a GF Score of 93/100, signaling strong profitability and momentum with a balance sheet that is solid rather than spotless. GF Value is $259.88, so the shares trade about 1% below it, fairly valued. The bull case is already in the price. The next test is whether AWS growth in the fourth quarter shows the $110 billion commitment turning into recognized revenue.

item.title: Global shares drop on AI worries, echoing Wall Street's decline despite the strong Anthropic debut
item.description: Global shares dropped in Friday trading as a wide selloff hits issues related to artificial intelligence and computer chips.
item.dc:creator: The Associated Press
item.content:encoded: NEW YORK — A bruising sell-off in artificial intelligence stocks on Friday pulled the S&P 500 down 3.7 per cent, dragging the index to its worst weekly loss in more than 18 months, and knocking the Nasdaq composite into the red for the year. The benchmark index is now in what professional investors call a “correction,” having fallen more than 10 per cent from its Oct. 6 all-time high. The last time the S&P 500 had a correction was March 2025, as the Trump administration’s trade war rattled the market. Its weekly loss, marking its worst such decline since April 2025, as the trade war escalated, capped a seven-day losing streak, the longest such string of losses since the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020. The Nasdaq composite, which is more greatly influenced by tech stocks, slumped 5.3 per cent, pulling it into negative territory for the year. Its weekly loss was also just shy of its worst week since March 2020, when the pandemic ground the global economy to a halt. The Dow Jones Industrial Average, with less exposure to technology stocks, fell 1.9 per cent. Chip stocks like Nvidia, Micron Technology, Broadcom and Advanced Micro Devices bore the brunt of the selling, but other companies connected to the AI buildout tanked as well, including the optical products company Corning and the energy provider Bloom Energy. The AI lab Anthropic, coming off a successful IPO Thursday, tumbled 9.1 per cent. The sell-off in technology stocks spread around the globe: Japan’s Nikkei and South Korea’s Kospi each fell more than 5 per cent overnight. European indexes fell sharply as well. AI stocks have hefty market values and have a much bigger impact on the market’s direction. They were responsible for Wall Street’s big gains this year and are now behind the big slide for the market. The AI trade has been losing steam partly over worries that AI stocks’ big market values and heavy spending are unjustified. Fears of a bubble within the sector have also been exacerbated by the results of the recent midterm elections, with candidates advocating for a slowdown in data centre construction winning at both the federal and state level. “The whole notion that AI can continue to spend unlimited amounts of money and support the stock market, I think the notion of that is ending as we speak, that’s what’s being priced right now,” said Michael Antonelli, market strategist at Baird. “But I don’t think that means that the overall bull market that started in October 2022 is over.” Much of the AI rout was centreed among chip stocks, which have been big beneficiaries of the build out of AI data centres. Advanced Micro Devices sank 13.3 per cent, Micron Technology slid 13.9 per cent and Broadcom fell 12.1 per cent. The PHLX Semiconductor Index sank 10.7 per cent. Corning slid 10.9 per cent and Bloom Energy gave up 15.3 per cent. Nvidia, considered by many to be the poster child for the AI boom, fell for the ninth day in the last 10, closing 13.8 per cent lower. The chip company’s stock was caught up in the market’s anxiety about the strength of the AI build out, and more recently has been pressured by worries about its future following the sudden downfall of Jensen Huang, its former CEO and co-founder. Since the Huang scandal erupted earlier this month, the stock has dropped more than 25 per cent. The big market debut for Anthropic, maker of the Claude AI tool, fizzled Friday with the rest of the tech sector. The stock fell 9.1 per cent to US$88.30, but remains above its IPO price of US$83 per share. It was the biggest public stock offering ever, at one point surpassing US$2 trillion in value. Anthropic’s share price drop on Friday amounts to a roughly 23 per cent decline from its brief peak of US$115.10 a share set the day prior. That’s an even bigger drop than the dive seen for Facebook (now Meta) in the early days after its May 2012 IPO. Market debuts for tech companies are often followed by a volatile period. SpaceX, which previously held the title for biggest IPO, rose nearly 50 per cent in its first three days, but fell below its IPO price a month later. Outside of tech, though, most stocks were gaining ground. Cheerios maker General Mills rose 3.7 per cent and homebuilder Lennar gained 1 per cent. All told, the S&P 500 fell 265.44 points to 6,910.39. The Dow dropped 949.73 points to 48,147.33, and the Nasdaq lost 1,261.47 points to close at 22,617.73. While the stock market’s mood has soured, the sentiment among American consumers appears to have brightened, a reversal of the dynamic seen earlier this year. The University of Michigan’s latest index of consumer sentiment rose sharply compared to last month, coming in slightly ahead of economists’ expectations. Consumers noted some relief from easing gas prices and improved expectations for business conditions following the midterm elections. Still, sentiment remains below where it was in February, before the start of the U.S. war with Iran. Treasury yields fell in the bond market. The yield on the 10-year Treasury fell to 4.93 per cent from 5.04 per cent late Thursday. Brent crude oil, the international standard, rose 0.6 per cent to settle at US$92.57 per barrel, amid continued tension near the Strait of Hormuz as the U.S. war with Iran continues. Saudi Arabia said on Friday that Iran-backed Houthi rebels had fired more missiles and drones at the kingdom days after it launched a major air campaign across Houthi-controlled parts of Yemen. Iraq apparently reached a compromise with a powerful Iran-backed militia it accused of smuggling oil. ___ Damian J. Troise and Alex Veiga, The Associated Press AP Business Writers Yuri Kageyama and Michelle Chapman contributed to this report.

Nvidia, considered by many to be the poster child for the AI boom, fell for the ninth day in the last 10, closing 13.8 per cent lower. The chip company’s stock was caught up in the market’s anxiety about the strength of the AI build out, and more recently has been pressured by worries about its future following the sudden downfall of Jensen Huang, its former CEO and co-founder. Since the Huang scandal erupted earlier this month, the stock has dropped more than 25 per cent. The big market debut for Anthropic, maker of the Claude AI tool, fizzled Friday with the rest of the tech sector. The stock fell 9.1 per cent to US$88.30, but remains above its IPO price of US$83 per share. It was the biggest public stock offering ever, at one point surpassing US$2 trillion in value. Anthropic’s share price drop on Friday amounts to a roughly 23 per cent decline from its brief peak of US$115.10 a share set the day prior. That’s an even bigger drop than the dive seen for Facebook (now Meta) in the early days after its May 2012 IPO. Market debuts for tech companies are often followed by a volatile period. SpaceX, which previously held the title for biggest IPO, rose nearly 50 per cent in its first three days, but fell below its IPO price a month later. Outside of tech, though, most stocks were gaining ground. Cheerios maker General Mills rose 3.7 per cent and homebuilder Lennar gained 1 per cent. All told, the S&P 500 fell 265.44 points to 6,910.39. The Dow dropped 949.73 points to 48,147.33, and the Nasdaq lost 1,261.47 points to close at 22,617.73. While the stock market’s mood has soured, the sentiment among American consumers appears to have brightened, a reversal of the dynamic seen earlier this year. The University of Michigan’s latest index of consumer sentiment rose sharply compared to last month, coming in slightly ahead of economists’ expectations. Consumers noted some relief from easing gas prices and improved expectations for business conditions following the midterm elections. Still, sentiment remains below where it was in February, before the start of the U.S. war with Iran. Treasury yields fell in the bond market. The yield on the 10-year Treasury fell to 4.93 per cent from 5.04 per cent late Thursday. Brent crude oil, the international standard, rose 0.6 per cent to settle at US$92.57 per barrel, amid continued tension near the Strait of Hormuz as the U.S. war with Iran continues. Saudi Arabia said on Friday that Iran-backed Houthi rebels had fired more missiles and drones at the kingdom days after it launched a major air campaign across Houthi-controlled parts of Yemen. Iraq apparently reached a compromise with a powerful Iran-backed militia it accused of smuggling oil. ___ Damian J. Troise and Alex Veiga, The Associated Press AP Business Writers Yuri Kageyama and Michelle Chapman contributed to this report.

item.description:
(見出しを修正します。)
［ニューヨーク ２０日 ロイター］ - 米国株式市場では売りが加速し、前日に続き主要３指数が...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
再送米国株式市場＝ナスダック5％安、ＡＩ懸念で　Ｓ＆Ｐ・ダウ調整局面 6:36 配信

２０１３年８月撮影　REUTERS/Lucas Jackson（ロイター） (見出しを修正します。)

［ニューヨーク　２０日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場では売りが加速し、前日に続き主要３指数が軒並み急落して取引を終えた。人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックの大型上場が市場の期待を支えるには至らず、今年の株高を主導してきたＡＩ関連銘柄に対する懸念が一段と強まった。

ダウ工業株３０種とＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種は最高終値から１０％超下落し、調整局面入りを確認。Ｓ＆Ｐは７営業日続落し、２０２０年２月以来の長い連続下落となった。

週間ベースでは主要３指数はいずれもトランプ米大統領が大型関税措置を発表した昨年４月以来の大幅な下落率を記録した。とりわけナスダックの週間での下げは、２０年３月以来最大となった。

ＵＳバンク・ウェルス・マネジメント（モンタナ州ビリングス）のシニア投資ディレクター、ビル・ノーシー氏は「資本市場にとって明らかに厳しい一日だった。週末を前に売り圧力はある程度加速しているように見える」と指摘。「ファンダメンタルズと投資家心理を比較すると、きょうは明らかに投資家心理が市場を支配している」とし、米経済の底堅さや企業業績の堅調さなどを挙げ、「短期的には投資家心理の方が常に強い力を持つが、時間がたてば最終的にはファンダメンタルズが勝る」と述べた。

この日は、前日にナスダック市場に上場したアンソロピックは９．１％安。半導体大手エヌビディアも１３．８％急落した。

アンソロピックのＩＰＯのほか、エヌビディアが今週発表した四半期決算も、ＡＩを巡るリスクや巨額投資に対する市場の懸念を払拭するには至らず、ハイテク株全体に売りが広がった。

売りは大規模クラウド事業者（ハイパースケーラー）にも及び、アマゾン・ドット・コムは３．９％安、メタ・プラットフォームズは５．９％安。「ネオクラウド」と呼ばれる新興クラウド企業のコアウィーブは１２．１％安、ネビウスも１６．１％安。

ＡＩ関連株が売りを浴びたことを受け、発電設備や非常用電源設備の需要低迷への懸念から、キャタピラーも５％下落した。

ホライゾン・インベストメント・サービシズ（インディアナ州ハモンド）の最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）、チャック・カールソン氏は、「エヌビディアは企業業績の歴史の中でも屈指と言えるほど素晴らしい四半期決算を発表し、あらゆる点で期待に応えた」とし、「多くの投資家はアンソロピックの上場が市場の不透明感を払拭するきっかけになると期待していたが、そうはならなかった」と述べた。

投資家の不安心理を示す「恐怖指数」として知られるシカゴ・オプション取引所（CBOE）のVIX指数は、２５年４月７日以来の高値で終了した。

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のクック理事は２０日、現在の金融政策スタンスは高水準のインフレに対処するには不十分であり、追加利上げが必要との認識を示した。

CMEのフェドウオッチによると、金融市場では１２月の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での０．２５％ポイント利上げがほぼ確実視されている。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を３．７７対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでも４．２７対１で値下がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は２５１億９０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１９５億株。

item.title: バンス氏「大統領支える」、イラン攻撃巡る自身の見解明言せず
item.description:
Bo Erickson Jacob Bogage
[ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Bo Erickson　Jacob Bogage

[ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] - バンス米副大統領は２０日、米国が２月にイラン攻撃に踏み切る決定はトランプ大統領の判断だったとし、「私の目標と職務は大統領を支えることだ」と述べた。自身なら攻撃を承認していたかとの質問には直接答えなかった。

ホワイトハウスで行われたトランプ大統領の記者会見に同席したバンス副大統領は、イランでの戦争が共和党の議会選挙敗北に見合うものだったかとの質問に対し、「イランの核兵器保有を阻止することが、まさにわれわれが取り組んでいることだ」と述べた。その上で、「最終的な決定を下すのは大統領だ。大統領自身も『（同じ状況になれば）再び同じことをするだろう』と述べている」と語り、対イラン作戦への支持には明言せず、トランプ大統領を支える姿勢を示した。

バンス氏は今月の中間選挙で共和党が敗北した後、イラン戦争が敗因だったと主張し、トランプ政権の対イラン政策との距離を置く姿勢を示唆していた。

トランプ大統領は「私の部下には意見を述べる権利がある」とし、バンス副大統領の主張に不満はないとしながらも、攻撃は必要で、同じ状況であればバンス氏も同じ判断を下していただろうという認識が欠如しているとの見方を示した。

item.description: [ジュネーブ ２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ジュネーブ ２０日 ロイター] - 国連安全保障理事会が２０日、グテレス事務総長の後任候補８人に対する非公式投票を実施した。外交筋３人によると、常任理事国２カ国が、本命とされるコスタリカのレベカ・グリンスパン氏に反対票を投じた。後任の年内選出が不透明となり、国連がトップ不在に陥る可能性が高まった。

グテレス事務総長は１２月末で２期目の任期を終える。

グリンスパン氏への投票結果は、賛成１０票、反対４票だった。反対のうち２票は、拒否権を持つ安保理常任理事国（ロシア、フランス、中国、英国、米国）からだった。秘密投票のため、どの国がグリンスパン氏に賛成または反対したかは明らかではない。これまでの８回の投票のうち７回で、同氏は８人の候補者の中で首位に立っていた。

FAST

Nov 20 : Coding startup Cognition AI is in funding talks at a $75 billion valuation, Bloomberg News reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter. The company is considering raising $2 billion or more in the latest round, the report said, adding that the talks were ongoing and the details could change. The news comes about two months after Cognition raised $2 billion in a Series E funding round at a valuation of $48 billion. The round was led by new investors Andreessen Horowitz and Accel, alongside existing backers Founders Fund, General Catalyst, and Avenir. Cognition did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. The company is an AI startup that develops autonomous software-engineering agents, which can plan, write, test and deploy code with limited human intervention. The company was valued at $26 billion in a funding round in May, when it raised $1 billion.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Nasdaq crashes 1,200 pts at close, erasing 2026 gains; S&P 500, Dow enter correction
item.description: US stocks experienced a steep selloff, leading to significant losses for major indexes like the S&P 500 and Dow. The selloff marked the biggest weekly declines since April 2025, confirming corrections for both indexes. Investor sentiment surrounding technology and AI stocks remains negative despite strong corporate earnings results. The Federal Reserve's potential interest rate increase continues to influence market expectations and trader strategies.
item.dc:creator: ETMarkets.com
item.content:encoded: US stocks extended their steep selloff on Friday, pushing the S&P 500 and the Dow into correction territory as Anthropic’s blockbuster listing failed to restore confidence in an artificial intelligence trade that had powered much of this year’s rally, Reuters reported.The S&P 500 dropped 257.38 points, or 3.59%, to 6,918.45. The Nasdaq Composite plunged 1,225.05 points, or 5.13%, to 22,654.15, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 908.88 points, or 1.85%, to 48,188.18.All three major indexes closed sharply lower and recorded their biggest weekly percentage declines since April 2025, when President Donald Trump announced his market-rattling “Liberation Day” tariffs.The S&P 500 and the Dow ended more than 10% below their record closing highs, confirming that both had entered corrections. The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite erased its gains for the year.The S&P 500 fell for a seventh consecutive session, marking its longest losing streak since February 2020.For live updates on US Markets, click here“This is clearly a challenging day for capital markets, and as we head into a Friday close, it appears to be accelerating to a certain degree,” Bill Northey, senior investment director at US Bank Wealth Management, told Reuters.“When we step back and evaluate fundamentals and sentiment, sentiment is clearly winning the day,” Northey added. “Sentiment is always the more powerful force in the immediate term, whereas fundamentals tend to win out over time.”Strong corporate earnings and a resilient economy offered little support as investors continued to retreat from technology and AI-linked stocks.Anthropic’s highly anticipated initial public offering had been viewed as a potential turning point for the battered AI trade. The shares closed 17.1% above their $83 offer price on Thursday but surrendered much of their early surge as enthusiasm faded during the session. The stock then posted a steep decline on its second day of trading.The IPO, together with Nvidia’s quarterly earnings report, failed to ease concerns about stretched valuations and the enormous sums being invested in AI infrastructure.“Nvidia reported what might have been one of the greatest quarters in corporate earnings history; they did everything right,” said Chuck Carlson, chief executive officer at Horizon Investment Services, as per Reuters' report.“A lot of people, myself included, were looking to the Anthropic debut to some extent as a clearing event, and it wasn’t.”The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, which had been a major driver of the broader market’s advance, tumbled as the once-crowded chip trade continued to unwind.Amazon and Meta Platforms were among the hyperscalers that suffered heavy losses, while AI cloud-computing companies CoreWeave and Nebius also fell sharply.The technology rout encouraged investors to move into traditionally defensive areas, including consumer staples and healthcare.Inflation and Fed policy in focusFederal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook said the central bank’s policy rate was not sufficiently high to address elevated inflation.Traders were pricing in a near-certain 25-basis-point interest-rate increase at the Fed’s December meeting, according to CME Group’s FedWatch tool.A University of Michigan survey showed an improvement in consumer sentiment following the election.Investors will turn next week to the personal consumption expenditures report, which includes the Fed’s preferred inflation measure, for further guidance on monetary policy after October inflation exceeded expectations.Among individual stocks, Intuit fell after lowering its annual revenue-growth forecast and agreeing to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for about $3.68 billion. Intuit acquired the business five years ago for nearly three times that amount.UnitedHealth Group advanced after TD Cowen upgraded the health insurer to “buy” from “hold.”Caterpillar declined as the retreat in AI-related shares raised concerns about demand for its power-generation and backup-power equipment.Bitcoin fell below $60,000, dragging down cryptocurrency-linked companies including Coinbase, Strategy and Robinhood.(Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

item.description: ［ニューヨーク ２０日 ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円などの主要通貨に対して下落した。米連邦準備理事...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル高一服、ＦＲＢタカ派姿勢継続観測で下げ幅限定 6:10 配信

２００９年１２月撮影　REUTERS/Sam Mircovich（ロイター） ［ニューヨーク　２０日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円などの主要通貨に対して下落した。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のタカ派化観測を背景にドルはここ数週間上昇していたが、ここにきて一服。ただ、高リスク通貨への投資意欲が減退していることなどでドルの下げ幅は限定されている。

終盤の取引で主要６通貨に対するドル指数は０．１％安の１０３．８６。前日は１０３．９近辺と、２０２５年４月以来の高水準を付けていた。

ドル／円は０．６％安の１５８．７８円。円は対ドルで上昇したものの、７月に日本当局が円買い介入に踏み切った水準に近い水準で推移している。

バノックバーン・フォレックスのチーフ市場ストラテジスト、チャンドラー氏は円相場のこの日の上昇について、米国債利回りの低下のほか、日本の１０月全国消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）が堅調だったことが支援材料になったとしている。

総務省発表の１０月の全国消費者物価指数（生鮮食品を除く総合指数、コアＣＰＩ）は、前年比２．２％上昇。伸び率は前月の２．１％上昇から小幅に拡大し、２カ月連続で２％台となった。

キャピタル・エコノミクスのアナリストは、このところの円安は長続きしない可能性が高いと指摘。長期的なインフレ期待はすでに日銀の目標近辺に達しているため、今後の金利上昇は主に実質金利の上昇によるものになるとの見方を示し、米国債利回りが低下するとの見通しと合わせ、円相場を押し上げる要因になると分析した。

ドル指数はこの日まで８営業連続で上昇し、月初からの上昇率は１．９％。米国のインフレ指標が予想を上回って上昇し、ＦＲＢが利上げを継続するとの見方が強まっていた中、ウォラーＦＲＢ理事が１２月会合での０．５％ポイントの大幅利上げを検討すべきとの考えを示したことなどで、ドルの上昇は勢いを増していた。

バノックバーン・キャピタル・マーケッツのチーフ市場ストラテジスト、マーク・チャンドラー氏は「ドルの上昇モメンタムは失われつつあるように見えるが、ドル相場が天井を付けたと判断するにはまだ少し早い」と指摘。ＡＩ（人工知能）を巡るさまざまな懸念が世界的な株式市場の重しになる中、米国債などの安全資産に資金が流入し米国債利回りの低下につながったことに言及し、金利が低下すれば、低金利通貨の相対的な魅力が高まることもあると述べた。

多くの市場関係者は、ＦＲＢのタカ派姿勢が続くとの見通しを背景にドルは引き続きある程度底堅く推移すると予想している。ＩＮＧのグローバル市場責任者、クリス・ターナー氏は、株式市場が大幅な調整局面に入る可能性はそれほど高くないとし、「ＦＲＢが近いうちにタカ派的な発言を弱める理由は見当たらない」と指摘。市場では来週発表される米個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）物価指数が注目されているとし、ＦＲＢのインフレ対応がなお必要と確認する内容になる可能性が高いとの見方を示した。

ＦＲＢの金融政策を巡っては、クックＦＲＢ理事がこの日、現在の金融政策スタンスは高水準のインフレに対処するには不十分で、追加利上げが必要との認識を表明。トランプ大統領はＦＲＢが「政治的」であるため、金利が高すぎるとの考えを示した。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）ビットコインは６％安の５万７９３９ドル。ＡＩ関連銘柄のバリュエーションの高さに対する懸念が強まる中、他のリスク資産とともに売り圧力にさらされ、７月以来初めて６万ドルの節目を割り込んだ。

ドル／円　ＮＹ終値 158.53/158.55

始値 158.80

高値 158.92

安値 158.43

ユーロ／ドル　ＮＹ終値 1.0967/1.0968

始値 1.0957

高値 1.1000

安値 1.0959

Wall Street regulator proposes to take control of market surveillance tool

FILE PHOTO: A Wall Street sign is pictured outside the New York Stock Exchange in the Manhattan borough of New York City, New York, U.S., October 2, 2020. REUTERS/Carlo Allegri/File Photo

FILE PHOTO: The headquarters of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) are seen in Washington, July 6, 2009. REUTERS/Jim Bourg/File Photo

FAST

Nov 20 : The US Securities and Exchange Commission on Friday proposed taking direct control of a comprehensive industry-funded market surveillance tool long the subject of cost and privacy complaints, the agency announced. The proposal makes good on the Trump administration's pledge to rework the so-called Consolidated Audit Trail, which the agency first mandated following the 2010 "flash crash," in which Wall Street indices temporarily erased nearly $1 trillion in market value in minutes. The surveillance system remains the only source of its kind for comprehensive, real-time data and information about market events — allowing regulators to reconstruct every order, route and execution for US-listed equities and options nationwide — making it crucial to investigations into possible market misconduct including insider trading and market manipulation. But investment industry and stock market operators have battled over who should foot the bill for its development and operations costs while conservative critics earlier decried what they said was the CAT's invasive collection of personal data.

SEC Chair Paul Atkins said in Friday's statement the changes would make the CAT "accountable in its governance and disciplined in its costs," to the benefit of both exchange operators and market participants. The system is currently operated by an organization overseen by the industry-funded Financial Industry Regulatory Authority. SEC officials told reporters on Friday the CAT's current annual operating costs were down about 45 per cent since 2024 to $137 million. But under Friday's proposal, stock exchanges and broker-dealers themselves would collect and report the same data to the agency or its designee, giving the SEC direct control, the agency said. The new rules would also subject the system's costs to annual funding legislation from Congress, something market operators and others warn could expose it to government shutdowns. The agency earlier this year eliminated the systematic collection and storage of traders' personal information such as names, addresses and dates of birth. The announcement confirmed that the Trump administration had stepped back from conservatives' most aggressive moves. The manifesto known as "Project 2025," to which Atkins was a contributor, called for the CAT's outright elimination. The proposal is subject to a 60-day public comment period prior to any decision on whether to adopt a final version.

Source: Reuters

item.description: [２０日 ロイター] - 米グーグル傘下の動画投稿サイト、ユーチューブが、米国の数千の学区に対し約３０億ドルを支払う可...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ユーチューブ、米学区と30億ドル支払いで和解へ　依存症訴訟で＝報道 5:58 配信

2025年9月11日に撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） [２０日 ロイター] - 米グーグル傘下の動画投稿サイト、ユーチューブが、米国の数千の学区に対し約３０億ドルを支払う可能性のある和解案で原則合意に達したことが分かった。ブルームバーグ・ニュースが２０日に報じた。学区側は、生徒の精神衛生を害する依存性の高いプラットフォームを設計したとしてユーチューブを訴えていた。

報道によると、合意には１０代の若者向けの安全対策も含まれており、過半数の学区が署名することが条件になっている。最終決着には数カ月かかる見通しだという。

和解には、訴訟を統括するカリフォルニア州オークランドのイボンヌ・ゴンザレス・ロジャーズ連邦地裁判事の承認が必要になる。

ユーチューブの親会社アルファベットはロイターのコメント要請にすぐには応じなかった。

他のプラットフォームと異なり、ユーチューブは学校の授業にも幅広く採用されている。

しかし、トーマス・Ｂ・フォーダム研究所が２０００人超の高校生を対象に９月に実施した調査では、３０％超が授業時間中、教師が指示する活動ではなく娯楽目的でユーチューブを使っていたことが分かった。

原告となっている学区はニューヨークやロサンゼルスから小規模な地域まで多岐にわたり、メタ・プラットフォームズ、スナップ、ティックトックも提訴している。レコメンド機能のアルゴリズムや自動再生、無限スクロールといった機能が若いユーザーを引きつけるよう設計され、うつ病や不安症、摂食障害の一因になったと主張している。

MEXICO CITY, Nov 20 : Mexican cellphone users reported widespread service outages on Friday affecting Telcel, AT&T Mexico and Movistar, marking the latest disruption to mobile networks in the country. Users began reporting problems around 11 a.m. local time, including an inability to make calls, loss of cellular signal and problems accessing mobile data, according to outage-tracking platform Downdetector.  • Telcel is controlled by America Movil, while Movistar remains operated by Spain's Telefonica while its sale to US consortium Melisa Acquisition is underway • Spokespeople for America Movil and Movistar did not immediately respond to requests for comment

item.description: FSLY fell 10.1% in the afternoon session after AI-linked shares continued to pull back. Anthropic slid more than 10% following its debut, failing to revive confidence in the sector's spending ...
item.content:encoded:
News / Stock Story / Why Fastly shares are trading lower today

Why Fastly shares are trading lower today 1 min read

FSLY

What happened? Shares of edge cloud platform Fastly FSLY fell 10.1% in the afternoon session after AI-linked shares continued to pull back. Anthropic slid more than 10% following its debut, failing to revive confidence in the sector's spending boom. Investors had looked to Anthropic's record $81.3 billion initial public offering and Nvidia's quarterly earnings beat under interim CEO Colette Kress to steady sentiment following Jensen Huang's resignation, CNBC reported. Instead, Anthropic's retreat toward its $83 offer price echoed Seaport Research warnings, covered by CNBC, that its valuation demands much faster revenue growth. Separately, Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook warned against delaying rate hikes ahead of an expected December increase. Compounding the concerns, President Donald Trump threatened penalties on overseas U.S. data-center builds as new Commerce Department export-licensing rules weighed on chipmakers. What is the market telling us Fastly’s shares are extremely volatile and have had 84 moves greater than 5% over the last year. But moves this big are rare even for Fastly and indicate this news significantly impacted the market’s perception of the business. Fastly is up 45.6% since the beginning of the year, but at $14.84 per share, it is still trading 55.7% below its 52-week high of $33.50 from April 2026. Despite the year-to-date gain, investors who bought $1,000 worth of Fastly’s shares 5 years ago would now be looking at only $359.77. ONE MORE THING: The $21 AI Application Stock Wall Street Forgot. While Wall Street obsesses over who’s building AI, one company is already using it to print money. And nobody’s paying attention. AI chip stocks trade at ridiculous valuations. This company processes a trillion consumer signals monthly using AI and trades at a third of the price. The gap won’t last. The institutions will figure it out. You need to see this first. item.title: Trump Threatens to Tax Firms Building Data Centers Abroad: Full Presser
item.description: President Trump delivered a wide-ranging briefing to reporters after returning from his trip to Asia, where he held a landmark summit with China's President Xi and Russia's President Putin. President Trump told reporters he plans to tax on firms building data centers abroad and said that US and China are working on a 'comprehensive' deal on chips. Trump also backed both former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, saying would like to see Huang return to the chipmaker and that he has not lost confidence in Lutnick. (Source: Bloomberg)

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 20 : Honda and Toyota Motor said on Friday they are recalling about 1.6 million cars, trucks and SUVs over a risk that Takata airbag inflators could rupture. Honda and Toyota both said there were no injuries or crashes tied to the vehicles being recalled, and there have been no airbag inflator ruptures. The automakers will replace the airbag inflators in the recalled vehicles. There have, however, been at least 28 deaths in the United States and more than 400 injuries stemming from defective Takata airbag inflators since 2009, an issue prompting the largest auto recall in US history. All of those deaths involved airbag inflators without a drying agent. At least 20 of those deaths were in Honda vehicles. The vehicles in the current recalls have airbag inflators that contain a moisture-absorbing material — unlike the millions of vehicles recalled previously.

The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration said analysis and inflator degradation simulation models conducted by independent testing groups allowed the automakers to act ahead of potential risks. "Honda and Toyota saw early evidence of degradation risk in certain of their vehicles and are currently conducting proactive recalls of vehicles," NHTSA said late Friday, adding that other automakers continue to conduct inflator analysis and testing. The recall includes 810,592 older Honda cars and SUVs in the United States and 790,000 Toyota vehicles worldwide, including 314,000 in the United States. The Toyota recall includes 2002-2010 Lexus SC430, 2011 IS250, 2017 GX460, 2003-2008 Toyota Corolla, 2005-2006 Tundra, 2005-2007 Sequoia and 2016-2017 4Runner. The Honda recall covers some 2013 Honda Accord, 2012-2013 Honda Civic, 2012-2013 Honda CR-V, 2013 Acura ILX and 2013 Acura RDX vehicles. The Honda recall covers vehicles originally sold or registered in 14 states or territories known for high temperature, humidity and large temperature fluctuations. Over the past decade, two dozen major automakers have recalled more than 100 million vehicles fitted with Takata airbag inflators worldwide, including about 67 million vehicles in the United States. Various automakers have also reported hundreds of injuries in vehicles since 2009 from Takata airbag inflators that can explode, unleashing metal shrapnel inside cars and trucks, killing or injuring drivers or other vehicle occupants. Honda said long-term monitoring and analysis revealed potential propellant degradation in certain inflators within specific geographic regions. Toyota warned that degraded propellant could cause the inflator to rupture if the airbag deploys and cause serious injuries. The Honda recall applies to vehicles sold or registered in Alabama, California, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Louisiana, Mississippi, South Carolina, Texas, Puerto Rico, US Virgin Islands, Northern Mariana Islands (Saipan), Guam and American Samoa. Toyota did not specify in which US states the recall applies but said it expects the replacement inflators will be ready by early 2027.

Source: Reuters

item.content:encoded:
News / Stock Story / MACOM, Amtech, Photronics, Impinj, and Allegro MicroSystems shares are falling, what you need to know

MACOM, Amtech, Photronics, Impinj, and Allegro MicroSystems shares are falling, what you need to know 2 min read

ASYS

What happened? A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session as AI-linked shares continued to pull back. Anthropic slid more than 10% following its debut, failing to revive confidence in the sector's spending boom. Investors had looked to Anthropic's record $81.3 billion initial public offering and Nvidia's quarterly earnings beat under interim CEO Colette Kress to steady sentiment following Jensen Huang's resignation, CNBC reported. Instead, Anthropic's retreat toward its $83 offer price echoed Seaport Research warnings, covered by CNBC, that its valuation demands much faster revenue growth. Separately, Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook warned against delaying rate hikes ahead of an expected December increase. Compounding the concerns, President Donald Trump threatened penalties on overseas U.S. data-center builds as new Commerce Department export-licensing rules weighed on chipmakers. The stock market overreacts to news, and big price drops can present good opportunities to buy high-quality stocks. Among others, the following stocks were impacted: Analog semiconductors company MACOM fell 8.2%. Is now the time to buy MACOM? Access our full analysis report here, it’s free. Semiconductor manufacturing company Amtech fell 10.4%. Is now the time to buy Amtech? Access our full analysis report here, it’s free. Semiconductor manufacturing company Photronics fell 7%. Is now the time to buy Photronics? Access our full analysis report here, it’s free. Analog semiconductors company Impinj fell 7.5%. Is now the time to buy Impinj? Access our full analysis report here, it’s free. Processors and graphics chips company Allegro MicroSystems fell 7.9%. Is now the time to buy Allegro MicroSystems? Access our full analysis report here, it’s free. Zooming in on Amtech Amtech’s shares are extremely volatile and have had 74 moves greater than 5% over the last year. But moves this big are rare even for Amtech and indicate this news significantly impacted the market’s perception of the business. The previous big move we wrote about was 7 days ago when the stock dropped 6% on the news that accelerating annual wholesale inflation pushed Treasury yields higher, while executive turmoil at Nvidia pressured chipmakers. The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported that October’s producer price index rose 0.3% month on month. That was marginally below the 0.4% increase expected by economists polled by Dow Jones, CNBC reported. However, unadjusted final demand climbed 6.5% over the past twelve months, the fastest annual pace since November 2022, pushing the 10-year Treasury yield up nearly four basis points to 5.14%. Northlight Asset Management Chief Investment Officer Chris Zaccarelli told CNBC that persistent price pressures keep the Federal Reserve on course to raise interest rates in December. When benchmark bond yields sit above 5%, elevated equity valuations face immediate discount-rate pressure. Amtech is down 16.1% since the beginning of the year, and at $10.86 per share, it is trading 54.7% below its 52-week high of $23.99 from June 2026. Despite the year-to-date decline, investors who bought $1,000 worth of Amtech’s shares 5 years ago would now be looking at an investment worth $1,027. ONE MORE THING: 3 Hidden Platforms Growing 3X Faster than Amazon, Google, and PayPal. Amazon, Google, and Meta all followed the same playbook: Dominate an ignored market. Build an unbeatable moat. Scale until you’re unstoppable. These three platforms are running that exact playbook right now. The early investors in Amazon made fortunes. The early investors in these could do the same.

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 20 : Alphabet's self-driving unit Waymo said on Friday it is issuing two recalls for its robotaxis over incidents involving closed freeway lanes and manual traffic control. Earlier this week, Waymo said it halted operations of its vehicles on US freeways, after a California regulator barred its vehicles from freeways in the state. The California ban, which took effect last week, is a result of a series of incidents where Waymo robotaxis entered active construction zones, the California Department of Motor Vehicles said. Waymo said a statement it filed two safety recalls with the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration on Thursday on its automated driving system "to strengthen how the Waymo Driver navigates closed freeway lanes and intersections with manual traffic control."

The closed freeway lanes recall stems from unusual circumstances where a Waymo vehicle may enter and continue driving in a closed freeway lane, the company said, adding it is still working on the recall remedy. Waymo said there were no collisions or injuries reported from the closed freeway events. The manual traffic recall is to ensure self-driving vehicles better responds to manual commands at intersections from law enforcement or other emergency personnel and follows a collision in which a Waymo followed directions from an officer, but the officer was then temporarily obstructed. That update was completed on November 6. Waymo says its technology outperforms statistically comparable human benchmarks and drastically reduces injury-causing crashes. Last week, NHTSA said it opened a recall query into Waymo vehicles after numerous incidents of its robotaxis passing stopped school buses. The probe will look into nearly 3,000 company-owned self-driving vehicles. Investigators want to determine whether a software update Waymo rolled out late last year failed to stop its driverless cars from passing school buses with flashing red lights. Most of the violations happened after the company said the remedy had been deployed. Separately, NHTSA and the National Transportation Safety Board have opened probes after one of Waymo's self-driving vehicles struck a child in January near an elementary school in Santa Monica, California.

Source: Reuters

item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（20日） 5:08 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

続落して取引を終えた。ＦＴＳＥ１００種は５日続落となり、終値として５カ月ぶりの安値を付けた。人工知能（ＡＩ）投資を巡る懸念や米利上げ観測などを背景に、週間ベースでは５．１０％安だった。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は前日比２．２３％安と７営業日続落。週間では４．６５％下落した。

銀行大手スタンダード・チャータードは前日比５．６％、ＨＳＢＣは３．６％、バークレイズは３．３％、いずれも下落した。

金属価格の下落を受けて、ＦＴＳＥ３５０種貴金属株指数は４．８３％、鉱業株指数は３．０３％、それぞれ下落。原油先物価格の下落を受け、石油・ガス生産を手がけるイサカ・エナジーは６．１％値下がりした。

一方、英日用品のユニリーバは２．２％、製薬大手ＧＳＫは０．８％、それぞれ上昇。電力・ガス供給のナショナル・グリッドは１．１％高だった。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

５日続落して取引を終えた。ハイテク株を含め幅広い銘柄で売り注文が優勢だった。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は週間ベースでは５．８０％下落と、２０２５年春以来の週間下落率だった。人工知能（ＡＩ）開発の米アンソロピックが大型新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）を果たしたものの、ＡＩを巡って依然として懸念が根強い状況が続いている。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種テクノロジー株指数は５．３９％安。オランダの半導体製造装置メーカーＡＳＭＬホールディングは９．３％、欧州の半導体大手ＳＴマイクロエレクトロニクスは１０．８％、それぞれ下落した。

ＳＴＯＸＸユーロ圏銀行株指数は２．８３％、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州高級品株１０種指数は３．０７％、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種航空宇宙・防衛株指数は３．４２％、いずれも下落した。

フランスの鋼管大手バローレックは１４．６％安。直近四半期が減益決算となり、売られた。フランスのバイオ医薬品会社アビバックスは１７．２％急落した。

一方、スイスの食品大手ネスレは１．３％高だった。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

域内国債利回りが低下した。ＡＩ（人工知能）セクターへの懸念から世界の株式市場が下落したことを受け、安全資産とされる国債に投資資金が向かった。

１９日にナスダック市場に上場したＡＩ開発企業アンソロピックの株価は、ＡＩ株全般への熱狂を呼び戻すには至らず、２０日は一時１０％下落した。

株式市場の弱気な地合いが、ユーロ圏の指標となる安全資産のドイツ国債に追い風となり、独１０年債利回りは１１ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の３．２９５％と、１日としては４月以来の低下幅となった。

独２年債利回りも１０ｂｐ低下し、３．０５９％となった。

ラボバンクのシニア金利ストラテジスト、リン・グラハム・テイラー氏は、株式市場の下落幅の大きさを考えれば、リスク回避の動きはさらに大きくなっていた可能性があると指摘。「債券利回りの動きとしては大きなものだが、これまでに見られた株式の下落幅に比べれば、特段大きいとは言えないだろう」と述べた。

フランス国債とイタリア国債の利回りは、それぞれ約７ｂｐ低下。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は約５ｂｐ拡大して１５８ｂｐとなった。

ユーロ圏金融・債券市場：[DE/BJ]

Ford, Honda, Stellantis, VW sue New Jersey to block 'extortionate' vehicle repair law

FAST

Nov 20 : Ford, Honda, Stellantis' FCA unit and Volkswagen sued New Jersey on Friday to block a new state law they say increases the amounts automakers must pay franchised dealers for warranty and recall repairs. In a complaint filed in federal court in Trenton, New Jersey, the automakers said the New Jersey Motor Vehicle Open Recall Notice and Fair Compensation Act gives dealers a "blank check" to set prices for warranty, recall and other repair services, while prohibiting manufacturers from avoiding "extortionate" results or recovering the costs. New Jersey's law will shift more than $375 million a year to dealers from automakers, giving dealers a "windfall" by imposing no obligation to use the money to improve customer service or boost compensation for employees, the automakers said. "In short, the act rewards dealers for charging their customers more," the automakers said.

The office of New Jersey Attorney General Jennifer Davenport, who enforces the state's laws, declined to comment. New Jersey's law took effect on April 1, after former Governor Phil Murphy signed it in September 2025. CONSTITUTIONAL VIOLATIONS ALLEGED The automakers objected to letting dealers charge a "labor multiplier" based on samples of repair orders, saying it lets dealers bill for substantially more labor time than they actually work. They also challenged provisions requiring automakers to pay marked-up prices on parts that the dealers received at reduced cost or for free, and preventing automakers from providing less expensive parts even if supply, demand or other factors justified price cuts. Ford, Honda, FCA — which includes Fiat and Chrysler — and Volkswagen said that since the law took effect, each has received dozens of bills requiring payment "for hours that no technician works, that surpass what comparable dealers charge for the same work, and that exceed what retail customers pay." They said the law violates the US Constitution's Commerce Clause and Takings Clause, is preempted by federal law governing recalls, and violates New Jersey's Constitution. The nonprofit advocacy group New Jersey Coalition of Automotive Retailers is also a defendant. Its president Laura Perrotta said she was confident the group would prevail. She accused automakers of having for decades "helped themselves" to deep discounts on parts and labor at dealers' expense, and said it is "not an option" for dealers competing for business to pass warranty and recall repair costs to consumers.

Source: Reuters

item.title: EXCLUSIVE-米ＳＥＣのエヌビディア調査、会計処理が焦点＝関係筋
item.description:
Chris Prentice Alexandra Alper
[ニューヨーク／ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] - 米証...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
EXCLUSIVE-米ＳＥＣのエヌビディア調査、会計処理が焦点＝関係筋 4:44 配信

２０２５年１月撮影　 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） Chris Prentice　Alexandra Alper

[ニューヨーク／ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] - 米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）が米半導体大手エヌビディアの会計処理を調査していることが複数の関係筋の話で分かった。

エヌビディアを巡っては、米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）が１７日、ＳＥＣが調査を進めていると報じたが、調査の焦点については確認できなかったとしていた。これに関連して、匿名を条件にロイターの取材に応じた関係筋は、ＳＥＣ執行部門の職員がエヌビディアの潜在的な会計上の問題を精査していると明らかにした。

ただ、ロイターはＳＥＣがいつ調査を開始したのか、監督当局が具体的にどのような会計上の問題を調べているのかについて、現時点で確認できていない。調査は不正行為の証拠を意味するものではなく、多くの場合、執行措置に至らず終了する。ただ、会計問題に焦点を当てた今回の調査を報じるのはロイターが初めてで、エヌビディアに対する圧力が強まる可能性がある。

この件に関して、ＳＥＣ報道官はコメントを控えている。エヌビディア広報担当者からコメントは得られていない。

ロイターは先月、エヌビディアによる人工知能（ＡＩ）新興企業ハギングフェイス買収計画（１２９億ドル）について、米司法省が買収案件や事業慣行を巡る広範な反トラスト法（独占禁止法）調査の一環として審査していると報じている。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：人民元に内外の圧力、海外は割安批判　国内は元高懸念 焦点：オープンＡＩの甘いセキュリティー管理、従業員は以前から警鐘 コラム：安全資産性薄まる金　リスクオフでも買われず アングル：米企業は四半期決算に固執か　政権が義務撤廃でも アングル：米株式取引24時間化、ウォール街では期待と慎重論が交錯 11/21(土) 4:44 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: ホルムズ海峡でタンカー被弾 炎上も死傷者なし＝ＵＫＭＴＯ
item.description: [カイロ ２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[カイロ　２０日　ロイター] - 英国海事貿易機関（ＵＫＭＴＯ）は２０日、ホルムズ海峡を航行中のタンカーが、正体不明の飛翔体に被弾して炎上したと明らかにした。

英海軍の関連機関であるＵＫＭＴＯは、今回の事案はオマーンの町ハサブの北方８カイリで発生したと述べ、死傷者や環境への影響は報告されていないと述べた。

イラン国営メディアの報道によると、イランのイスラム革命防衛隊（ＩＲＧＣ）はその直後、ハサブ付近でホルムズ海峡の通過を試みていた原油タンカーが機雷に接触して炎上したと発表した。

ハサブはホルムズ海峡の入り口に当たるオマーンのムサンダム半島に位置する。

FAST

Nov 20 : YouTube has reached an in-principle agreement to potentially pay about $3 billion to thousands of US school districts that accused it of designing an addictive platform that harmed students' mental health, Bloomberg News reported on Friday. The deal also includes product safeguards for teens and is contingent on a majority of districts signing on, with finalization likely to take a few months, the report said, citing people familiar with the matter. Any settlement would have to be approved by US District Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers in Oakland, California, who is overseeing the litigation. The districts, ranging from New York City and Los Angeles to smaller communities, have also sued Meta Platforms, Snap and TikTok, alleging that features such as recommendation algorithms, autoplay and infinite scroll were designed to hook young users and contributed to depression, anxiety and eating disorders.

The companies have denied the claims. YouTube parent Alphabet did not immediately respond to Reuters' request for comment. Unlike the other platforms, YouTube has been broadly adopted by schools for classroom use. A September survey of more than 2,000 high-school students by the Thomas B. Fordham Institute found that over 30 per cent used YouTube for entertainment rather than teacher-directed activities during the school day. The schools say they have had to spend money enforcing phone bans and hiring mental-health staff, and they are seeking funds and platform changes. The next federal school trial, involving Tucson, Arizona, is set for February, with Meta, TikTok and Snap still defendants, the report added.  In August, Meta agreed to pay up to $18 billion over the next decade and strictly limit how teenagers use Facebook and Instagram to settle claims by nearly all US states that it designed its platforms to addict children.

Source: Reuters

item.title: トランプ氏、海外にデータセンター建設の米企業に罰則科す方針 対中ＡＩ競争で
item.description:
Bo Erickson Courtney Rozen
[ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Bo Erickson　Courtney Rozen

[ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２０日、海外にデータセンターを建設する米企業に罰則を科す方針を示した。米国の人工知能（ＡＩ）分野が中国勢と競争するのを後押しすることが目的だとした。

トランプ氏はホワイトハウスでの記者会見で、ＡＩについて言及した上で、「われわれは米企業が海外にデータセンターを建設することを認めない」と表明。海外にデータセンターを建設する企業には「莫大な税金」を課すと述べた。

データセンターは、ますます複雑化するＡＩシステムの学習や稼働に必要な計算能力を提供するため、ＡＩブームにおいて極めて重要であり、こうした措置が世界的なＡＩインフラの拡充を複雑にする可能性がある。

トランプ氏は米国内でのデータセンター建設を強く推進してきたが、この立場は有権者の間で不評を買っている。データセンター建設は、電力需要や電気料金など地域への影響を巡る懸念から、全米各地で反対を招いている。

item.title: イタリア全土で賃上げ求めストライキ、労組呼びかけ 学生も参加
item.description:
Giselda Vagnoni
[ローマ ２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Giselda Vagnoni

[ローマ ２０日 ロイター] - イタリア全土で２０日、労働組合の呼びかけによるストライキが実施された。２０２７年にイタリア議会選を控える中、労組側は賃上げや公共サービスへの投資拡大を求めており、各地で学生らも活動に加わった。欧州広域で生活費の高騰や軍事費の増加に抗議する動きが目立っており、ドイツやフランス、英国、オーストリア、ベルギー、スペインでも学生によるデモが計画されている。

イタリア最大の労働組合であるイタリア労働総同盟（ＣＧＩＬ）のリーダー、ランディーニ氏は２０日、「欧州全土の一般市民の間で、変革を求める声が高まっている」とし、イタリア国内１００を上回る都市でデモが行われ、参加者は１００万人を超えたと主張した。ただ内務省はまだ参加者数を推計する段階にはない、としている。

ストには学校や医療関係者も参加。航空・鉄道サービスは対象外だが、別の鉄道ストが予定されており、他の労組も個別のストを呼びかけた。

イタリアでは１０月３０日にも学生らが教育資金増や生活・住宅費高騰への対策を求め、ストに加わった。それ以降、学生らは軍事費増加への反対も掲げ、大学などで抗議や占拠を続けている。

イタリア議会は現在、２７年度予算案を審議している。ＣＧＩＬは公共サービスなどの対策が不十分だと主張。インフレで損なわれた購買力を回復するための賃上げや、年金への完全な物価スライド制度の適用などを求めている。

item.title: 米財務省、シンガポールとマレーシアにイラン制裁の順守要求 違反リスクを警告
item.description:
Gregor Stuart Hunter
[シンガポール ２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Gregor Stuart Hunter

[シンガポール ２０日 ロイター] - 米財務省当局者は今週、マレーシアとシンガポールの規制や安全保障担当などの当局者と相次いで会談し、イランに対する米制裁を順守するよう求め、違反した場合のリスクを警告した。海運や航空サービス、調達網など「リスクが高い」部門で、イランのダミー企業として機能していないかどうかを精査するよう求め「標的にすべきライフラインが見つかった場合は、交渉の余地はない」と強調した。

米政権はイランとの戦闘の早期終結を目指し、８月にイランに対して「オペレーション・エコノミック・アウトキャスト（経済的追放作戦）」を始めるなど制裁を強化している。米当局者は「マレーシアへ就航中、もしくは最近まで就航していたイランの航空会社がある」ことから、この問題を取り上げたとした。航空会社の具体名は明かさなかった。

米海軍は今年４月以降、ホルムズ海峡を航行してイランに向かう船舶を対象に封鎖措置を実施。１１月にはイランの国境やカスピ海を経由する移動に対しても取り締まりを強化している。

イラン産原油を巡っては、タンカーが積み替えのためマレーシアやシンガポール、インドネシア周辺で寄港することで、原産地が分かりにくくなることが常態化していた。マレーシア当局は２０２５年、積み替えに関する規制を厳格化すると表明し、今年２月にはタンカー２隻を押収するなどしている。

item.title: トランプ氏、ラトニック氏の「信頼変わらず」 フアン氏は謝罪し復帰を
item.description: ［ワシントン ２０日 ロイター］ - トランプ米大統領は２０日、人工知能（ＡＩ）向け半導体大手エヌビディアを巡る不祥事を...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
トランプ氏、ラトニック氏の「信頼変わらず」　フアン氏は謝罪し復帰を 4:17 配信

トランプ米大統領（左）とジェンスン・フアン氏。2025年4月30日、ワシントンで撮影。 REUTERS/Leah Millis/File Photo（ロイター） ［ワシントン　２０日　ロイター］ - トランプ米大統領は２０日、人工知能（ＡＩ）向け半導体大手エヌビディアを巡る不祥事を受け、中国向け半導体販売への対応を巡り批判が高まっているラトニック商務長官について、「非常に優れた実業家だ」とし、これまでと変わらない支持を示した。

エヌビディアを巡っては、ジェンスン・フアン前最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と交際関係にあった女性が中国のスパイだった疑惑が浮上。トランプ氏は今週のアジア歴訪後に開いた記者会見で、フアン氏について中国の習近平国家主席と協議したと明らかにした。ただ、その際の会話の詳細には触れなかった。

ラトニック氏を巡っては１１月の中間選挙で大勝した民主党が、同氏が公職上の立場を利用して息子らが支配する投資会社キャンター・フィッツジェラルドを、エヌビディアと中国企業との関係に対する監視強化に伴う損失から守ろうとしたかどうかを調査している。

トランプ大統領は記者会見で「私は信頼を失っていない。彼は一風変わった人物だが、非常に優れた実業家だ」とし、「非常に良い仕事をしていると思う」と述べ、ラトニック氏を擁護した。

フアン氏については「謝罪し、復帰してほしい」と述べた上で、「この件について習主席とも話した。習主席は『彼は素晴らしい、実に素晴らしい人物だ』と言っていた。本当にその通りだ」と語った。また、エヌビディアは米国にとって非常に重要な企業との認識を示した。

ベセント財務長官はこの日のＣＮＢＣのインタビューで、米中首脳会談でフアン氏、およびフアン氏と交際関係にあった中国人女性を巡るスパイ疑惑について議題に上がらなかったと述べており、トランプ氏の発言と食い違っている。

米紙ニューヨーク・タイムズはこの日、フアン氏と交際関係にあった女性で、米当局が中国のスパイと疑っているアリス・フアン氏について、中国の防衛産業と広範なつながりを持っていると報じた。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：トランプ氏、レガシー欲しさの北朝鮮接近に危うさ　交渉に入れば譲歩圧力も アングル：「手負い」のトランプ氏、貿易相手国に好機か　強硬化への警戒も 焦点：トランプ氏に路線転換圧力、中間選挙惨敗で共和党内に不満広がる 焦点：交渉か軍事行動拡大か、トランプ氏が直面する対イラン選択肢 アングル：民主勝利でもトランプ氏は関税路線堅持、政策転換シナリオ見込めず 11/21(土) 5:28 最終更新 ロイター

item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２０日、イランが放射性物質を飛散させる「ダーティーボム（汚い爆弾）」を製造しているとの「うわさ」があると述べ、イランが実際に製造している場合、米国は阻止するとの考えを示した。

トランプ氏はまた、イランは戦闘終結に向けた合意を望んでいると改めて主張。ただ「イランは合意を望んでいるが、私が受け入れられる内容の合意を望んでいるわけではない」と述べた。

米ＣＮＮは米情報機関の分析として、イランがダーティーボムの製造を試みており、米首都ワシントンでそれを爆発させる可能性があると報道。トランプ氏は１７日、この報道について深刻に受け止めていると述べていた。ロイターはこの報道を独自に確認できていない。

UK finds fix for fridge and freezer vulnerability after European hacks

FAST

LONDON, Nov 20 : A British cybersecurity operation has fixed a flaw in the operating systems of commercial fridges and freezers used by supermarkets, warehouses and restaurants, helping protect them from hacks that hit several European countries in recent weeks. A wave of cyberattacks knocked out commercial fridges and freezers from Sweden to Belgium earlier in November, while a similar hack hit France in October, forcing stores to throw away millions of euros' worth of food. It was thought Britain had largely escaped the hacks because its refrigeration industry relies on different devices, but those working with retailers found a flaw that could have provided an opening for hackers. "We were aware of a small number of UK organisations that may have been affected as a result of vulnerabilities on their systems, and the National Cyber Security Centre immediately took steps to alert and support those that could have been impacted," an NCSC spokesperson said.

Following the attacks in Europe, Germany's information security office warned of continuing vulnerabilities in some of Danish firm Danfoss' industrial cooling appliances. French intelligence and cyber agencies accused Iran's Revolutionary Guards of carrying out the October hack, which targeted 700 commercial sites and caused 15 fires after hackers raised temperatures in refrigeration systems. The vulnerability affecting British refrigeration systems was identified by consultants at Omega Systems, before ethical hackers from cybersecurity firm Pen Test Partners found a series of additional openings and contacted security services. Pen Test Partners said the operation lasted for about three weeks and was carried out in secret so as not to alert hackers. Before the fix could be made, the affected companies removed fridges from the open internet and prioritised efforts to secure the devices. The NCSC said it shared security advice with food and retail organisations to ensure they took measures to mitigate the risks.

Source: Reuters

item.title: トランプ氏、プーチン氏とウ巡り良好な協議 米中ロ会談は強い一体感
item.description: [ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２０日、中国で行ったロシアのプーチン大統領との会談について、ウクライナ情勢を巡り「非常に良好な」協議を行ったと明らかにした。一方で、ウクライナの安全保障については、和平合意なしに交渉する考えはないと述べた。

トランプ大統領はホワイトハウスでアジア歴訪に関する記者会見を開き、ウクライナ和平合意について「非常に良い話し合いができており、実現できる可能性は十分にあると思う」と語った。

また、「プーチン大統領はロシアとウクライナの戦争を外交的手段で終結させたいという明確な意思を示した」と述べ、和平交渉を仲介している米交渉担当者の取り組みを評価した。

ただ、「問題はウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領とプーチン大統領の間に途方もない憎しみがあることだ。決して容易ではない」とも指摘した。

トランプ大統領の娘婿で特使でもあるジャレッド・クシュナー氏は１９日、トランプ大統領がロシアとの和平合意の一環としてウクライナに安全の保証を提供することに前向きだと述べた。ただ、そうした合意はより広範な安全保障の枠組みの一部でなければならないとした。

ロシアのリャプコフ外務次官は２０日、ウクライナに北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）型の安全の保証を与える構想に反対し、ウクライナのＮＡＴＯへの「準加盟」はいかなる形であれ、ロシアとして到底受け入れられないと明言した。ロシア国営メディアが報じた。

こうした見解の食い違いについて問われたトランプ大統領は交渉上の戦術だと説明。「こちらが何か言えば、彼らも何か言うだろう」としつつも、「私が言えるのは、プーチン大統領はこの問題を解決したいと考えているということだけだ。それに間違いはない」と強調した。

中国の習近平国家主席、プーチン大統領との米中ロ会談については、核兵器の拡散防止について協議し、強い一体感があったと明らかにした。

トランプ大統領は「地球全体での核の脅威の拡散阻止に向けて協力する必要性について話し合った」とし、「特に、イランが決して核兵器を保有しないことを確実にすることについて、深く議論した」と述べた。

item.title: No further curbs needed on Nvidia chip sales to China: US Treasury secy
item.description: Bessent said existing restrictions and curbs on remote access to advanced semiconductors were sufficient, a day after lawmakers flagged approvals for over 850,000 Nvidia and AMD chips to Chinese firms ...
item.content:encoded:
Home / World News / No further curbs needed on Nvidia chip sales to China: US Treasury secy

No further curbs needed on Nvidia chip sales to China: US Treasury secy Bessent said existing restrictions and curbs on remote access to advanced semiconductors were sufficient, a day after lawmakers flagged approvals for over 850,000 Nvidia and AMD chips to Chinese firms

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent | Image: Bloomberg

AP Washington 4 min read Last Updated : Nov 21 2026 | 8:00 AM IST

Listen to This Article

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has said no further restrictions on the sale of older Nvidia chips to China are needed following the Trump administration's move earlier this week to block China's remote access to the latest semiconductors. The ability of Chinese tech firms to access Nvidia's technology came under scrutiny after CEO Jensen Huang stepped down amid allegations of his affair with an executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company that uses advanced chips to generate computing power that Chinese firms access remotely. "The proper chip restrictions are in place," Bessent said in an interview with CNBC on Friday after returning from a trip to Asia with President Donald Trump. "And the remote access has been curtailed."   Bessent's comments came a day after the House Foreign Affairs Committee released details of the Commerce Department's approval of the sales of more than 850,000 chips from Nvidia and its competitor AMD to Chinese companies. The Pentagon has identified some of those companies as having ties to the Chinese military.

The report tracked applications from Nvidia to sell its H200 chips -- one of its more powerful products, though not the most advanced -- and AMD's applications to sell its roughly comparable MI325X chip to companies that are either located or headquartered in China, or entities with parent companies based in China. The Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security approved the export, re-export, or transfer of 879,868 of these chips to companies with Chinese ties across 21 license applications as of May 11, 2026, the report said. Nvidia and AMD had requested to sell a cumulative total of more than 3.4 million of the chips to Chinese-tied companies across those applications, per the report.

Also Read

Threats, insults, settlements: How Jensen Huang made humiliation routine

US approved AI chip sales for China firms, including Tencent, Alibaba: Data

The approvals, which don't necessarily indicate completed sales, included 75,000 for Alibaba, 150,000 for Tencent and its subsidiaries, 43,000 for Baidu, and 4,000 for BYD, according to the report. Each of those companies has been identified by the Defense Department as having ties to the Chinese military. The report shows the Commerce Department has a "long track record of transparency with Congress about licensing activity for the H200 and equivalent chips, including both approvals and rejections", a spokesperson for the Bureau of Industry and Security said in a statement Friday. The spokesperson said the Commerce Department's approach to H200 licensing is based on a rule in the Federal Register that was published in January. The rule imposes "significant additional national security-related requirements on license applicants in order to qualify for case-by-case consideration rather than a presumption of denial," the spokesperson said.

An Nvidia spokesperson said in a statement on Friday that the "limited shipments we made under the H200 programme were legal and authorised" by the BIS. "The review and licensing process spanned more than half a year, with approvals subject to strict conditions and limited volumes," the company spokesperson said. Earlier this week, Nvidia said it was no longer shipping H200 chips to China. The spokesperson said on Friday that shipments had stopped despite prior approvals. AMD said it complies with US export control laws and regulations and maintains "rigorous processes to ensure compliance across our global operations" in a statement from a spokesperson Friday. "We remain focused on serving our customers and upholding the highest standards of integrity," the spokesperson said.

Chinese technology firms have been bracing for impacts on their ambitious AI development plans as scrutiny mounts on export controls in the US. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick has been under intense scrutiny himself in the wake of the turmoil following the Huang affair. Last week, Bessent said he was frustrated with the Commerce Department's delay in placing restrictions on Nvidia chip exports to Megaspeed International, which is under investigation by the US for potentially diverting restricted Nvidia AI chips to China. A former executive at the company who allegedly had an affair with Huang was reportedly suspected by US intelligence agencies of being a spy for China.

In an unusually public rebuke of a fellow Cabinet member, Bessent said his department wanted to place export controls on Megaspeed, but Commerce was in charge of the matter. Speaking to reporters on Friday, Trump said he has "not lost confidence" in Lutnick. Calling him a "different kind of guy," Trump said he "has a natural business instinct" and has "done a very good job".

(Only the headline and picture of this report may have been reworked by the Business Standard staff; the rest of the content is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

FAST

Nov 20 : A shareholder activist group called for online brokerage Robinhood to review its proxy-voting platform, concerned that retail investors aren't getting fair choices as financial regulators weaken balloting rules for corporate annual meetings. Robinhood and its Say investor-communications arm are at the center of changes coming to contests like director elections or CEO pay approvals. Robinhood worked with Tesla to create a way for retail investors to cast their ballots automatically that won approval from the US Securities and Exchange Commission in September. Backers say such retail-voting plans will increase retail investors' voting participation rates, even as the SEC takes steps that could eliminate shareholder proposals at corporate meetings. Critics say Tesla and others like ExxonMobil are designing their programs to unfairly channel votes in favor of management recommendations. A shareholder resolution filed with Robinhood for its next annual meeting, seen by Reuters, could spark debate about the role of investor rights. In the resolution the activist group As You Sow says Robinhood limits customers to using its own voting platform that requires a "painstaking and time-consuming challenge" to vote on individual corporate ballot items, rather than using third-party voting services.

It also notes Robinhood's work with Tesla's management-friendly voting option. The limited voting choices create legal and reputational risks, said As You Sow in its resolution, which calls for Robinhood to review offering clients more ways to vote, "including an independent voting service of their choice." As You Sow leaders said ideally Robinhood might offer something like Vanguard's voting program which casts prorated shares of funds' votes according to investors' preferences. Vanguard clients can select among voting policies like one that tends to support environmental and social shareholder resolutions, or one that supports management recommendations. Robinhood "shouldn't be limiting choices," said Danielle Fugere, As You Sow president, in an interview. "You should get to choose. That's what voting is all about." Robinhood representatives did not respond to messages seeking comment.

Source: Reuters

ROME, Nov 20 : Italy has given provisional approval to Tesla's Assisted Driving System (TAD), Transport Minister Matteo Salvini said on Friday, making it the first major European Union country to embrace the technology developed by the U.S. electric vehicle maker. In a post on X, Salvini said the decision was "another step forward toward innovation, technology and the mobility of the future". The green light followed "a thorough technical feasibility assessment", the minister said, and came ahead of an ongoing European Union approval process. Tesla's CEO Elon Musk wrote back on X: "Thank you, much appreciated!"

TAD, formerly known as Full Self-Driving (FSD), is a so-called 'hands-off, eyes-on' system, that allows a vehicle to drive autonomously while requiring continuous supervision from a behind the steering-wheel. Several smaller EU countries have already taken the same step as Italy. After receiving initial approval in the Netherlands in April, the system was subsequently recognised in countries including Lithuania, Estonia, Denmark, and Belgium, allowing Tesla to expand its footprint ahead of a broader EU vote. Tesla also said on X on Friday that TAD had been approved in Italy, posting a video from inside one of its cars navigating the streets of Rome in autonomous mode.

item.title: US judge declines long-term ban on Trump admin's taxpayer-funded ads
item.description: A New York federal judge said the plaintiffs failed to show that taxpayer-funded advertisements were still causing imminent and irreparable harm after the November 3 midterm elections ...
item.content:encoded:
Home / World News / US judge declines long-term ban on Trump admin's taxpayer-funded ads

US judge declines long-term ban on Trump admin's taxpayer-funded ads A New York federal judge said the plaintiffs failed to show that taxpayer-funded advertisements were still causing imminent and irreparable harm after the November 3 midterm elections

The incremental victory for the Trump administration comes as a parallel case unfolds in Washington, DC | Image Credit: Bloomberg

AP New York 2 min read Last Updated : Nov 21 2026 | 7:52 AM IST

Listen to This Article

A federal judge has declined to issue a long-term ban on the Trump administration's controversial taxpayer-funded political advertisements, leaving their future in the hands of a different judge who is overseeing a similar case. US District Judge Jennifer L Rochon in New York argued on Friday that the suing coalition, which includes the government watchdog group Common Cause, didn't convincingly prove the ads were still causing them "imminent and irreparable harm" now that November's midterm elections are over. "The urgency of the earlier requests for temporary injunctive relief in this case centered around the November 3, 2026, midterm and state elections," Rochon wrote in a court filing. "Those elections have now passed."   The incremental victory for the Trump administration comes as a parallel case unfolds in Washington, DC.

In that case, the Democratic National Committee has asked the court for a preliminary injunction to stop the Trump administration from developing, distributing or airing the ads. The judge hasn't yet ruled on that matter after a hearing earlier this week. At issue in Friday's ruling were TV spots the Trump administration started airing in September that were paid for at least in part by a USD 20 million Department of Homeland Security contract. Also Read

Trump admin cleared over 879k AI chip sales to Chinese firms: House panel

US approved AI chip sales for China firms, including Tencent, Alibaba: Data

Some of the ads glorified the president with highlight reels of scenic speeches and callouts about tax cuts and support for law enforcement. One of them repurposed a clip that had been used by Trump's 2024 presidential campaign, showing him walking down a hallway as his voice can be heard warning of a "final battle" against "globalists" and "warmongers."   Some of the ads also appeared on Trump administration social media channels and the White House website.

The plaintiffs had argued the ads were illegal government-sponsored propaganda intended to promote the president's campaign message just weeks before Election Day. The White House has defended the ads as public service announcements. The judges in both cases issued temporary restraining orders blocking some of the ads in the lead-up to the election. A temporary restraining order in the Democrats' case expires next week. Bradley Girard, senior counsel at Democracy Forward, which represented the plaintiffs in the New York case, said while the team is disappointed, "we will continue to pursue this case on the merits to prevent this from happening in the future."   The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

(Only the headline and picture of this report may have been reworked by the Business Standard staff; the rest of the content is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

SEATTLE: When pressed by one of its largest unions, Boeing management declined to say on Thursday (Nov 20) if the company plans on further layoffs after an upcoming round next month. "We asked if December 9 was the only date for (layoff notices) and were told Boeing didn't know," Bryan Corliss, a spokesman for the Society of Engineering Employees in Aerospace, told Reuters. In early November, Boeing announced plans to cut 5 per cent of the company's commercial airplanes division's roughly 50,000 employees through attrition and layoffs . The cuts were needed because it is taking longer than expected for the company to increase output of its 737 MAX jet, its largest moneymaker, the division's CEO Stephanie Pope explained in a memo to employees at the time. Asked about SPEEA's comment, a Boeing spokesperson told Reuters, “We continue to work through an established process to ensure our workforce can support our customer commitments. We are committed to treating everyone with dignity and respect and will communicate details with impacted employees once decisions are finalised.”

The company is trying to increase 737 production rate from 42 jets a month to 47, which it had planned to reach this past summer. Last month, Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg told investors that the company now expects to reach that target in early 2027.

Related:

Boeing flags 737 MAX software glitch affecting landing navigation feature: Report

On Thursday, SPEEA told its roughly 17,000 members that Boeing managers told union officials that: "Employment at all Boeing Commercial Airplanes sites is under review, but layoffs won’t necessarily impact all sites. "These will not be across-the-board layoffs , but rather targeted layoffs focused on which work statements are ending or can be ended. "There will be no voluntary layoffs or buy-outs." SPEEA members approved a new four-year contract with the company in early October. Boeing managers told the union that the cuts were not retaliation for the contract, which included a guaranteed 10 per cent wage increase upon ratification, along with annual raises of 4 per cent and the possibility of an additional 2 per cent pay hike based on performance.

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 20 : President Donald Trump said on Friday that the US would penalize American companies that build data centers overseas, a move he said is intended to help the US artificial intelligence sector compete with its Chinese counterparts.  "We're not going to allow our companies to build data centers outside of our country," Trump said while discussing AI at a White House news conference following his trip to Asia. He said he would impose a "tremendous tax" on companies that build data centers abroad. Data centers are critical to the AI boom because they provide the computing power needed to train and run increasingly complex AI systems, and a penalty could complicate the global AI buildout. Data center developers often locate facilities close to users to reduce delays for time-sensitive tasks such as payment processing. Transmitting large volumes of data over long distances can also add significant costs. Trump has been a staunch advocate for data center construction in the US, a position that is unpopular with voters. Data centers have drawn opposition in communities nationwide over concerns about electricity demand, utility costs and other local impacts.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 高インフレ抑制に追加利上げ必要、現行の金利水準は不十分＝クックＦＲＢ理事
item.description:
Michael S. Derby
[２０日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のクック理事は２０日、現在の金融...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
高インフレ抑制に追加利上げ必要、現行の金利水準は不十分＝クックＦＲＢ理事 3:01 配信

クックＦＲＢ理事。9月28日、米カリフォルニア州オークランドで撮影。REUTERS/Ann Saphir/File Photo（ロイター） Michael S. Derby

[２０日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のクック理事は２０日、現在の金融政策スタンスは高水準のインフレに対処するには不十分であり、追加利上げが必要との認識を示した。

クック理事はチリでの講演原稿で、インフレ率が極めて高く、ＦＲＢの目標である２％を長期間上回っている現状を踏まえ、「別の環境であれば、連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）は忍耐強く待つ余裕があっただろう。しかし、現在の経済情勢ではそのような余裕はないと考える」と述べた。

ＦＲＢが９月のＦＯＭＣで実施した０．２５％ポイントの利上げでは、現在のインフレ水準を抑制するには不十分と指摘。「先週公表された指標を含め、９月の利上げ以降に入手したインフレデータからは、インフレが持続的に低下する軌道に戻りつつあることを示す十分な証拠は確認できない」とし、「インフレが低下していることを示す証拠はほとんどない」と語った。

政策金利の据え置きが決定された１０月のＦＯＭＣで反対票を投じ、０．２５％ポイントの追加利上げを主張したことについては、「インフレ抑制に取り組む必要性を強く感じていることを反映したものだ」と説明。「インフレ率は５年半以上にわたり目標を上回っている」とし、企業や家計のインフレ期待が上振れするリスクへの懸念を示した。

さらに、「利上げの実施を遅らせれば、政策対応が後手に回るリスクがある」と指摘。「後手に回れば、その後追いつくためにより大幅な利上げが必要となる可能性があり、金融システムへの負担を増大させるほか、家計にも不必要な悪影響を及ぼしかねない」と警告した。

一方で、金融環境は依然として緩和的で、経済に必要な引き締め効果をもたらしていないとの認識を示した。

同時に、米経済については楽観的な見方を示し、経済成長は「力強く加速している」としたほか、労働市場も「堅調」と評価した。

クック氏はまた、人工知能（ＡＩ）業界による投資資金の調達方法がますます複雑化していることにＦＲＢは注視していると指摘。「われわれは、規模だけでなく、金融取引が入り組んでいることを懸念している」とし、「金融安定性の観点から言えば、急速に拡大し、透明性を欠き、複雑性を伴うものには、すぐにわれわれの注意が向けられる」と述べた。

さらに、ＡＩによって一部の雇用が失われると考える一方、ＡＩが長期的に経済にもたらす効果については楽観視しているとも述べた。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：金価格、米国債利回り上昇でも4000ドル台維持　中銀の準備資産分散が下支え コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 コラム：米10年債利回り、利上げ局面でどこまで上昇　6％到達も視野 アングル：ＦＯＭＣで利上げほぼ確実、ウォーシュ氏の政策説明も不可避か コラム：ＦＯＭＣと日銀会合、金融政策ウイークの注目点＝植野大作氏 11/21(土) 6:27 最終更新 ロイター

NEW YORK, Nov 20 : Apollo and Goldman Sachs have priced a roughly $44 billion debt package to finance SpaceX's acquisition of Nvidia's GPU chips and related equipment, marking what the firms said is the largest AI-related chip financing ever arranged. Investor demand exceeded supply, allowing the transaction to be upsized. The proceeds are expected to help bankroll SpaceX's deployment of Nvidia's next-generation Vera Rubin chips as it expands its terrestrial AI computing footprint. The $25.17 billion of senior secured A3 notes maturing in April 2033 priced at a yield of 8.259 per cent, according to a source familiar with the sale. About $4.4 billion of senior secured A2 notes maturing in April 2031 were sold at 7.66 per cent, the source said, while $2.564 billion of class B subordinated secured April 2033 notes were sold at 8.36 per cent.

Categories: Markets

Stock image.

Copper slumped again on Friday, tipping the metal into a bear market just ten weeks after it set an all-time high, as the unwinding of bets on the artificial intelligence boom, a strong dollar and fading US tariff prospects continued to swamp evidence of acute shortage in China.

Comex copper for December delivery, the most active contract in New York, dropped as much as 3.4% to $5.4405 a pound ($11,994 a tonne), the lowest since the end of March, before recovering to $5.4995 around midday, down 2.4%. That is 20.2% below the record settlement of $6.8885 reached on September 9. A close under $5.51 would meet the common definition of a bear market, a fall of 20% or more from the most recent peak.

The contract has fallen for seven sessions in a row and is down more than 9% since last Friday, by far its steepest weekly loss of 2026. A year-to-date gain that stood at 22% in September has turned into a loss of 2%, and copper is on course to end November about 15% lower.

On the London Metal Exchange, three-month copper fell 2.3% to $12,235 a tonne in official trading after touching $12,020, the lowest since March 24, Reuters reports. The benchmark is down about 9% on the week, its biggest weekly fall since early April 2025, when US President Donald Trump unveiled his global tariffs. London copper is 18% below its September 10 peak of $14,875 and would have to drop under $11,900 to join New York in a bear market. In Shanghai, futures racked up their worst week in 15 years, according to Bloomberg.

Next stop, the March low

The break below $5.63, where copper ended 2025, removes the first of two chart supports that Saxo Bank’s Ole Hansen flagged during Wednesday’s rout . The second is $5.32, which sits just beneath the lowest close of 2026: $5.34 on March 20, when surging oil prices during the Iran war and swelling exchange inventories sent the metal to a three-month trough. Copper is now less than 3% above that level.

Evidence is mounting that the AI investment boom is waning and that the Federal Reserve will have to get more aggressive to control inflation, Kyle Rodda, senior financial market analyst at Capital.com, told Reuters, adding that a strengthening dollar is also weighing on the metal. AI shares continued to sag on Friday, with Anthropic trading about 9% below Thursday’s close after its market debut, the news agency said.

“We have been saying for as long as AI has been driving the price that this might be a bit over-egged,” Albert Mackenzie, copper analyst at Benchmark Mineral Intelligence, told Bloomberg. Weak Chinese demand, the dimming prospect of US tariffs and the dollar are also at work, and the week’s losses are not far off the slumps seen in the early stages of the pandemic and after Trump’s Liberation Day announcement. London copper is heading for its steepest monthly decline since 2022 .

Metal heads to China

The selloff in futures is still running alongside a scramble for physical metal in China. The Yangshan premium paid to import copper into the country slipped to $495 a tonne on Friday from Thursday’s record $500, Reuters reports. It was $360 on Wednesday and less than $100 in September. Shanghai Futures Exchange stocks rose by 3,204 tonnes this week to 30,846 tonnes, which is still less than a day’s worth of Chinese consumption.

That tightness may be part of what is pushing futures down. Premiums at these levels have made it profitable to move metal out of the United States, where stockpiles ballooned over the past year on tariff bets, and traders have begun shipping copper from the US to China , with tens of thousands of tonnes due to arrive in January. Codelco is meanwhile offering Chinese buyers 2027 cathode at $250 to $280 a tonne , less than it charged this year.

The flow looks set to continue. China’s refined copper imports are poised to climb in 2027 after a rare drop this year, according to a Reuters poll of 15 analysts and traders, because shortages of concentrate and scrap are holding back domestic smelter output while demand keeps growing. Imports fell 16% to 2.37 million tonnes in the first ten months of 2026, the lowest for the period since at least 2015.

“The gravitational pull of refined copper is now towards China,” said Nicholas Snowdon, head of metals and mining research at Mercuria, although Argus expects a moderate recovery rather than a surge.

In London the squeeze has eased: cash copper was at only a slight premium to the three-month contract on Friday after flipping into a discount earlier in the week.

$127 billion in a week

Copper stocks were sold again in New York. Eleven of the largest copper-exposed miners have lost a combined $127 billion, or 15% of their market value, since last Friday, and $208 billion, or 23%, over the past month. Their combined worth has dropped to $696 billion from $769 billion on Wednesday morning.

Freeport-McMoRan fell another 5.4%, taking its loss for the week to 22% and cutting its market value to $67 billion, from close to $100 billion a month ago. Southern Copper gave up 4.3% to $116 billion and has shed 32% in a month, a slide that has pushed the stock into the red for 2026 after it was up 41% in mid-October.

BHP was little changed at $177 billion but is down 14% on the week, and Rio Tinto eased 1.3% to $127 billion. Glencore, at $71 billion, has lost a fifth of its value in a month. Teck Resources dropped 3.6% to $24 billion, Antofagasta 4.8% and First Quantum Minerals 3.7%, and Lundin Mining’s 2.3% decline left it 19% lower since last Friday.

Only BHP, Glencore, Teck and Anglo American are still showing gains for the year, and Anglo’s is down to 1%. Ivanhoe Mines has lost 60% in 2026.

(With files from Reuters and Bloomberg)

item.content:encoded:
ビットコイン、7月以来初の6万ドル割れ　ＡＩ株安でリスク資産に売り 2:22 配信

仮想通貨「ビットコイン」。2025年9月10日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） Hannah Lang

[２０日 ロイター] - 世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）であるビットコインが２０日、７月以来初めて６万ドルの水準を割り込んだ。割高感への懸念が人工知能（ＡＩ）関連銘柄やその他のリスク資産の重荷となった。

ビットコインは直近で３．４５％安の５万９３８１ドル。イーサリアムは５．２３％安の１６４８．９１ドルとなった。

暗号資産市場はここ数日、巨額のＡＩインフラ投資の収益性に対する数週間にわたる懸念に揺さぶられてきた。金利の上昇や、米中間選挙での民主党勝利を受けた規制リスク、エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン前最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の退任も影響している。

item.title: UK man convicted of planning petrol bomb attack on migrant hotel
item.description: LONDON: A British man prosecutors said was motivated by extreme right-wing ideology was convicted on Friday (Nov 20) of planning a terrorist attack with petrol bombs on a hotel housing asylum seek

UK man convicted of planning petrol bomb attack on migrant hotel

Journalists stand outside of Newcastle Crown and Magistrates' Court in Newcastle-Upon-Tyne, north east England on Dec 9, 2024. (Photo: AFP/Andy Buchanan)

FAST

LONDON: A British man prosecutors said was motivated by extreme right-wing ideology was convicted on Friday (Nov 20) of planning a terrorist attack with petrol bomb s on a hotel housing asylum seekers. Mikka Lee Anderson, 24, was found guilty of targeting the Royal Hotel in Hull, northeast England, including by making Molotov cocktails and conducting reconnaissance. The hotel had previously been the focus of violent anti-migration riots that swept Britain in 2024 after the murder of three young girls in Southport. Anderson denied intending to commit any violent acts, but prosecutors told jurors that Anderson had told an associate of his plan to attack the hotel and "kill as man y of the migrant s who were housed inside it as possible."
